notes: The deep check after a sprint now counts your stride rate — steps per second, counted from the thigh and knee angles in your own clip and labeled 'measured'. It only shows when the clip had enough pose samples to count honestly (uploads slowed down for measuring); the live camera runs too slow to count steps, so it stays silent there instead of guessing. One glitched frame can't invent a step, and when the far leg is hidden on a side view the near leg's stride cycle carries the count instead.
